understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through all KA59 levels by moving/arranging the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, which triggers WIN for the level; completing all levels wins the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction, unless blocked or altered by walls/boundaries. If a pushable object is immediately adjacent in the movement direction, the piece can push it so both move together (subject to space/wall constraints). Walls act as obstacles that can prevent movement, though some boundaries may behave inconsistently and need to be tested. When multiple selectables exist, control is switched by CLICKing the exact pixel-coordinate position of another selectable; subsequent MOVE actions apply to that selected piece.

understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction, unless blocked or altered by walls/boundaries.
